facts.fact: Communications Minister Samuel Nartey George directed GIFEC to extend services to three more Sekyere Afram Plains communities after inspecting four Rural Telephony Project sites on 13 October 2026, saying the project extends coverage to communities operators may find commercially unviable.

The government is working with MTN Ghana to deploy 800 new telecommunications sites nationwide, at locations identified through Members of Parliament as having persistent network problems, with Sekyere Afram Plains communities prioritised.
